constraints: One full desktop application page per image, no laptop or phone frame, no browser chrome
High fidelity with readable carefully spaced text, aligned numbers and crisp icons
No real private data, credentials, tokens, banking IDs, or user identity

No fabricated claims of live implementation; these are visual concepts
